title: Casual Friday
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Casual Friday," Michael returns to announce casual Fridays and a new meeting format, but tensions rise when Pam and Ryan join as salespeople with clients taken from other staff. Dwight challenges Michael over the stolen clients, leading to a mutiny among the sales staff demanding their clients back. Michael admits fault but rescinds his apology, causing further conflict. Ultimately, Michael decides Pam gets the sales job, offering Ryan his temp position back, while Toby cancels casual Fridays, sparking protests.
